title: Public Deliberation Plan: Police Station Surveillance Transparency and Digital Evidence Bill
proposal: Police Station Surveillance Transparency and Digital Evidence Bill

publication.plain_language_summary: Mandatory 24x7 CCTV in all police station areas, officer body-cams, 18-month data retention, evidence invalidation for un-explicated outages.
publication.full_draft: Draft text published on MHA portal.
publication.impact_notes: Digital evidence and police transparency impact notes.
publication.evidence_register: Paramvir Singh Saini judgment, Supreme Court orders.

deliberation.stakeholder_roundtables: Roundtables with Bar Association, cyber forensic experts

remedies.reconsultation_trigger: Substantive structural changes to data retention rules
